# Wealth Notes

> Personal finance insights on budgeting, saving, investing, and building wealth with clarity and confidence.

Wealth Notes is a personal finance blog covering practical budgeting systems, beginner-friendly investing, and debt payoff strategy, written for people who want clear, sustainable money habits rather than hustle-culture advice.

## Pages

- [Home](https://wealthectual.vercel.app/): Overview of the site's core topics — budgeting, investing, and debt.
- [Journal](https://wealthectual.vercel.app/blog/): Full archive of articles.
- [About](https://wealthectual.vercel.app/about/): Who writes Wealth Notes and what the site is for.
